entries.title: Job 22:1
segments: ¶Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 22:2
segments: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself? {as he...: or, if he may be profitable, doth his good success depend thereon?}

words.text: unto himself? {as he...: or, if he may be profitable, doth his good success depend thereon?}

entries.title: Job 22:3
segments: [Is it] any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or [is it] gain [to him], that thou makest thy ways perfect?

words.text: [to him], that thou makest thy ways

entries.title: Job 22:4
segments: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?

entries.title: Job 22:5
segments: ¶[Is] not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?

entries.title: Job 22:6
segments: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing. {the naked...: Heb. the clothes of the naked}

words.text: For thou hast taken a pledge
. {the naked...: Heb. the clothes of the naked}

entries.title: Job 22:7
segments: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

entries.title: Job 22:8
segments: But [as for] the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it. {mighty...: Heb. man of arm} {honourable...: Heb. eminent, or, accepted for countenance}

words.text: in it. {mighty...: Heb. man of arm} {honourable...: Heb. eminent, or, accepted for countenance}

entries.title: Job 22:9
segments: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

entries.title: Job 22:10
segments: Therefore snares [are] round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;

entries.title: Job 22:11
segments: Or darkness, [that] thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.

entries.title: Job 22:12
segments: [Is] not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are! {height of the stars: Heb. head of the stars}

words.text: they are! {height of the stars: Heb. head of the stars}

entries.title: Job 22:13
segments: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud? {How: or, What}

entries.title: Job 22:14
segments: Thick clouds [are] a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.

entries.title: Job 22:15
segments: ¶Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?

entries.title: Job 22:16
segments: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood: {whose...: Heb. a flood was poured upon their foundation}

words.text: : {whose...: Heb. a flood was poured upon their foundation}

entries.title: Job 22:17
segments: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them? {for: or, to}

entries.title: Job 22:18
segments: Yet he filled their houses with good [things]: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

entries.title: Job 22:19
segments: The righteous see [it], and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.

entries.title: Job 22:20

entries.title: Job 22:21
segments: ¶Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee. {him: that is, God}

words.text: now thyself with him, and be at peace

entries.title: Job 22:22
segments: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.

entries.title: Job 22:23
segments: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.

entries.title: Job 22:24
segments: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the [gold] of Ophir as the stones of the brooks. {as dust: or, on the dust}

entries.title: Job 22:25
segments: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver. {defence: or, gold} {plenty...: Heb. silver of strength}

words.text: . {defence: or, gold} {plenty...: Heb. silver of strength}

entries.title: Job 22:26
segments: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.

words.text: For then shalt thou have thy delight

entries.title: Job 22:27
segments: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.

words.text: unto him, and he shall hear

entries.title: Job 22:28
segments: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.

entries.title: Job 22:29
segments: When [men] are cast down, then thou shalt say, [There is] lifting up; and he shall save the humble person. {the humble...: Heb. him that hath low eyes}
